changelog:
Initial release focused on simplified auto-memory integration with HermesClawZero.

- Automatically saves key chat facts and preferences to a local HermesClawZero vector database for persistent context.
- Loads recent user memory and profile context at the start of new chat sessions for better personalization.
- Allows full chat history backup to the database upon user request.
- Instructions provided for setting up scheduled background jobs (cron) to maintain and tag memories and send daily highlights.
- Emphasizes user consent and local-only data storage for privacy.
summary: Auto-capture chat to Hermes DB, load context on fresh chats, scheduled DB maintenance.
